resources.string: Extra space per 1 mm of descent: %1$s mL
Volume change = projected area × displacement (converted to cm)

The chest is simplified to a fixed cross-section with a moving floor. This shows only the geometric space made by the diaphragm. It omits rib motion and tissue deformation and does not estimate how much air a person breathes.
Schematic chest cross-section, not to scale. Blue dashed line: resting diaphragm. Solid teal line: lowered diaphragm.
